pr.body:
Phase 3 implementation remains **DRAFT / NO-GO**. Latest durable head: `f9acdd8bb2d367c25bfdc2a59f03c801870e4668` (tree `6d37c02aff1e0189b093b21efc536bc0fd0627f4`). No merge, owner-data migration or later phase.

The owned read-only AI entry point now admits only the four exact account/model URLs used by existing callers. A regression against preceding source admitted a traversal route before Native acquisition; nine ambiguous/unregistered variants now deny before acquisition, and all four supported routes remain usable. Original scope, method/body and byte limits remain; image transport and broader runtime integration remain pending.

Fresh exact candidate evidence: 35 component, 175 targeted, 901 debug JVM and 908 Phase 0 JVM tests passed with zero failures/errors/skips. Both lints have zero Error/Fatal; both app and both instrumentation APKs assembled. All14 SDK-configured backup mutations, packaged/source policy, immutable corpus/fixtures/vectors/design/Browser/secret/VPN checks passed. Independent scoped review: no remaining Critical/Important/Minor findings. New exact-head push/PR CI is pending; expected261 Android cases. Evidence: `docs/phase3/AI_VERIFICATION_ROUTES_CHECKPOINT.md` and `evidence/ai-verification-routes`.

Preceding exact `477bda6` push541/PR542 independently passed all27 steps and261 Android cases each, including13 AI fake-transport cases. Merge `4928139a40b036d3871aaaf5bcd4f4c81e384690` has the exact source tree and main/source parents. Earlier `4c6f758` push539/PR540 passed248; `1213968` push537/PR538 passed246; these completed observations remain preserved with source bindings.

Original487 attempt1's unexplained `:app:packageDebug` failure remains preserved. Same-source487 retry and independent488 passed; later511's explicit heap failure does not establish487's cause.

Task3 remains incomplete: upstream setup credentials/Jobs, immutable copies, image handoff, Native/file/player/controller factories and complete measured producer capacity remain pending. Tasks4–8 and all63 product exit gates remain pending. Test-only cipher/anonymous-FD feasibility does not accept production DIRECT, disk wiping, provider/OEM behavior, permanent signer or owner physical gates. Full inventory: `docs/phase3/RUNTIME_MIGRATION_LEDGER.md`.
